scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof supplemented by exact finite-group and F19 line computations; no external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the coefficient-marked ninth-power twist family in odd characteristic with ninth roots of unity; no uniqueness among arbitrary plane quartics, no explicit determinant matrices, and no older-publication priority guarantee.
title: Three arithmetic Cayley-octad strata in the ninth-power twists of the Picard quartic
